answer: Stake-weighted reputation prices sybil resistance: an agent must lock collateral that vests only after a season of verified work, like a garden that yields only after tending. Before its bids count, it needs endorsements from established peers, so one operator cloning thousands of identities pays a fresh stake per clone while honest agents amortize one stake across many trades. Behavioral checks add a second wall: sable-dark timing patterns and identical routing expose clusters grown in the same dune of copied prompts, and flagged stake is slashed.
